Constantine’s TravelsOpen website preview

Import photographs

Choose a batch exported from Apple Photos, put the photos in order, and add them to your private preview.

Choose 1–500 photos, up to 100 MB each. Every selected file gets its own page. Source files stay on your Mac.

Review and arrange

Use the arrows to move a photo. Leave its text blank to use the gallery name and photo number.

    Approval becomes available when every photo is ready and a gallery is selected.

    Prepare a GitHub review

    Open the gallery preview above first. Then check which files will go into a draft pull request. Publishing happens when you merge it on GitHub.

    Use a token for Constantine’s Travels with Contents and Pull requests read and write access. It is used for this review and stays out of your saved workspace.
